Game Overview

Dream Hopping Courier is a platformer game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Dream Hopping Courier is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Dream Hopping Courier?

Dream Hopping Courier is a free platformer game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Dream Hopping Courier free to play?

Yes, Dream Hopping Courier is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
